language.description: ISO 639-1 language code for the user interface.

show_updates.description: Whether to show notifications when new versions of Repetier-Host are available.

auto_check_updates.description: Whether to automatically check for updates on application startup.

baud_rate.description: Default serial baud rate for printer communication.

serial_port.description: Default serial port device path for the connected 3D printer.

retry_connection.description: Automatically retry connection if the initial attempt fails.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of connection retry attempts.

response_timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for waiting for a response from the printer.

log_file_path.description: Custom path for the log file. Empty string uses the default location in ~/.mono/registry.

trusted_gcodes.description: List of G-code commands that are trusted to run without confirmation prompts. Example: ['G1', 'G28']. For security, default to empty.
